items.title: The concerning stat that shows Australia's attack needs to lift
items.description: Without question, Australia will need to do better going forward, but perhaps their defence could see them through.

items.title: 'Panicked' Putin has big decision to make, and 'could go nuclear'
items.description: The Russian president's decision to annex Crimea showed the world his authoritarian muscle. These days, it is a "personal humiliation".

items.title: Widow warns of shock ambulance bill after husband's unexpected death
items.description: Private health insurers can legally avoid ambulance bills because corpses are not considered patients, a loophole that left a grieving widow shocked.

items.title: Indonesian soldiers recover body of US pilot killed in Papua
items.description: A video shows an operation by the Indonesian military to recover the body of an American pilot, shot dead by Papuan separatists in the Papua Highlands.

items.title: West Coast star Adam Hunter's 'grieving best mate' slams AFL leadership
items.description: In a five-page letter to the executives and commissioners of the AFL, a grieving best mate has slammed the organisation for "failing" former West Coasts player Adam Hunter, who suffered from CTE.

items.title: Man who spent eight days stuck under collapsed shopping centre in Venezuela rescued alive
items.description: Hernan Alberto Gil Flores, a 43-year-old Venezuelan man was dug out alive from under the ruins of a collapsed shopping centre, eight days after devastating earthquakes shook the nation.

items.title: Interpol issues wanted notice for Monaco bombing suspect
items.description: Investigators are hunting for a woman they say "disguised herself as a man" in connection with in a bomb attack that targeted a wealthy businessman in Monaco.

items.title: Curnow hits front in Coleman Medal race as Swans and Crows record wins
items.description: Charlie Curnow kicks six goals as the Swans cruise to a 35-point win over the Bulldogs, while Adelaide holds off a fast-finishing West Coast in Perth.

items.title: Speculation of 'reconciliation' as Prince Harry prepares to travel to UK
items.description: Prince Harry says he is still trying to bring his family to Britain next week, despite concerns of a "frenzy" as paparazzi attempt to snap rare photographs of his children.

items.title: Souths captain Cody Walker apologises after kicking opponent
items.description: South Sydney captain Cody Walker has said he let his teammates down after being sin-binned on Friday night for kicking an opposition player.

items.title: Veteran NSW Liberal quits frontbench amid ICAC inquiry
items.description: Veteran NSW Liberal Damien Tudehope has quit the frontbench after being called as a witness in a looming corruption watchdog probe.

items.title: Worst start to ski season since 1957, as blizzard finally dumps snow
items.description: Following the worst start to a ski season in decades, a major snowstorm hit the NSW and Victorian Alps last night.

items.title: China's latest activities near Taiwan indicate new strategy
items.description: Australia raises concerns about China's latest activities near Taiwan "directly to Chinese officials" as tensions simmer in the region.

items.title: Ohio town in shock after 16 kids found in squalor 'right under our noses'
items.description: Just days after authorities removed 16 children from a squalid home and arrested four adult relatives, the question looms over their southern Ohio village: how could this have happened, for years, unnoticed?

items.title: How to keep your home warm if you're renting or on a budget
items.description: If you're searching for ways to make your home warmer, these easy and inexpensive tricks can make a big difference.

items.title: Court hears doctor unknowingly communicated with self-described paedophile vigilante
items.description: A Perth paediatrician alleged to have sexually assaulted child patients was unknowingly communicating online with a self-described paedophile vigilante, a court has heard.

items.title: 'Deadly' Indigenous remote artists travel to Sydney
items.description: Remote Indigenous artists from around Australia are in Sydney for the annual National Indigenous Art Fair.

items.title: Can the Socceroos beat Egypt?
items.description: Can the Socceroos beat Egypt and win their first ever knockout final at a World Cup?  The Pharaohs have Salah, Marmoush and a dangerous counterattack, but the Socceroos have the physical edge, aerial threats and set-piece power to cause serious problems. We take a closer look Egypt's strengths, and why Australia are a dangerous underdog that shouldn't be written off.

items.title: 'An insult': How AI entered Sydney's underground music scene
items.description: Local musician Aidan Sammut says he was disgusted after a live music event aimed at showcasing local artists included an artist who used AI-generated content.

items.title: Renewables company ZEN Energy enters voluntary administration
items.description: ZEN Energy was once an emerging player in the nation's renewables transition but has now entered voluntary administration, saying its viability had been impacted by "wholesale electricity volatility".

items.title: For decades Australian house prices have grown. This is what a fall could mean
items.description: After decades of growth, Australian house prices are slowing. Here's what a fall could look like.

items.title: 'Similar to a blender': Gina Rinehart defends helipad amid noise concerns
items.description: Mining billionaire Gina Rinehart wants to be able to land a helicopter on the roof of her corporate HQ, and says the noise experienced by nearby residents would be similar to using a coffee machine or blender.

items.title: Meeting to decide Moira Deeming's future cancelled amid court battle
items.description: Victorian MP Moira Deeming has won a two-week reprieve as a Liberal candidate for the November state election, after the party agreed in the Supreme Court to cancel imminent plans to revoke her preselection.

items.title: Hype or reality, Taylor Swift's NYC wedding could transform the industry
items.description: Fans believe they know the when and where of Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce's upcoming nuptials, but much of the reported two-day extravaganza will likely be a cloak-and-dagger operation.

items.title: MP calls for investigation into anti-abortion campaigner
items.description: Anti-abortion campaigner Joanna Howe has been called out for potentially breaching campaign financing laws, with one MP labelling her "attack" style as harmful and dangerous.
